sources.citation: P. Erdos and E. G. Straus, On the irrationality of certain Ahmes series (1964), Theorem 3
sources.relationship: closest antecedent for the LCM-weighted signed limsup criterion and the eventual Sylvester conclusion
sources.exact_locator: Primary-host PDF, printed p. 132 (PDF p. 4): Theorem 3; printed p. 129 (PDF p. 1) front matter and pp. 129-133 for theorem context
sources.exact_statement_extracted: Theorem 3 assumes (i) limsup n_k^2/n_{k+1} <= 1 and (ii'') limsup [N_k/n_{k+1} * (n_{k+1}^2/n_{k+2} - 1)] <= 0; then sum 1/n_k is rational iff n_{k+1}=n_k^2-n_k+1 eventually.
supports: Primary-source attribution for the signed-limsup theorem and its eventual Sylvester conclusion
does_not_support: The local positive-part reformulation as a verbatim Erdos-Straus theorem statement
The full Erdos 243 target without its stated hypotheses
sources.packet_verification: The complete five-page scan was acquired and visually checked. Theorem 3 is on printed p. 132 and has the non-strict hypotheses limsup n_k^2/n_(k+1) <= 1 and limsup (N_k/n_(k+1))*(n_(k+1)^2/n_(k+2)-1) <= 0. The public paper's displayed >0 statement is the valid contrapositive after the one-step reindexing, under the ratio-limit hypothesis; the positive-part limit formulation is derived rather than the authors' literal wording.

derived_positive_part_reindex_check.sign_safe_consequence: If the positive part of the packet term tends to zero, the source term has limsup at most zero.
derived_positive_part_reindex_check.source_sign_condition: The scan's Theorem 3 hypothesis is the non-strict limsup <= 0, so positive-part convergence to zero matches the source sign condition at the displayed-term level.

sources.citation: D. Duverney, Irrationality of fast converging series of rational numbers, J. Math. Sci. Univ. Tokyo 8 (2001), 275-316, Corollary 3.2
sources.relationship: published conditional signed-series criterion whose all-positive specialization is the closest direct antecedent for the public paper's summability statement
sources.exact_locator: Publisher PDF, printed p. 287 (PDF p. 13): Corollary 3.2, equations (3.5)-(3.6); proof on printed pp. 299-300 (PDF pp. 25-26)
sources.exact_statement_extracted: Corollary 3.2 assumes u_n in N\{0}, u_n -> +infinity, sum_{n=0}^infinity (u_{n+1}/u_n^2 - 1) < +infinity, and a_n in {-1,1}; then sum_{n=0}^infinity a_n/u_n is rational if and only if u_{n+1}=u_n^2-(a_{n+1}/a_n)u_n+a_{n+2}/a_{n+1} for every n >= N.
supports: Primary-source attribution for the conditional signed-series criterion and its stated eventual recurrence

sources.citation: Junnosuke Koizumi, Irrationality of the reciprocal sum of doubly exponential sequences, arXiv:2504.05933; INTEGERS 26 (2026), A28
sources.relationship: closest antecedent for the pseudo-greedy integer-state recurrence and the eventual-nonnegative gap criterion
sources.exact_locator: arXiv v1 PDF p. 2, Theorem 1 and Corollaries 2-3; PDF p. 3, Theorem 4, Erdős-Graham Question 5, and Conjecture 6; PDF pp. 9-12, Theorem 16, Lemma 15, Proposition 19, and Corollary 20
sources.exact_statement_extracted: Theorem 1 gives the pseudo-greedy nearest-integer reconstruction under the stated ratio and reciprocal-sum hypotheses; Theorem 16 on PDF p. 10 proves that Conjecture 6 is equivalent to an affirmative answer to Erdős-Graham Question 5; Proposition 19 and Corollary 20 on PDF p. 12 record the eventual-zero-gap criteria and their sequence consequence.
sources.supports: Primary-source attribution for the pseudo-greedy state recurrence, the eventually nonnegative gap criterion, and the explicit equivalence with the open Erdős-Graham question.
sources.does_not_support: A solution of Erdős-Graham Question 5, a universal termination theorem, or any claim that the local equivalence is progress beyond the open problem.
sources.packet_verification: The hash-pinned arXiv LaTeX source was line-checked. Lemma 15 supplies the integer-state recurrence, Lemma 13 the zero-gap absorption, Proposition 19(2) the eventual-nonnegative gap criterion, Corollary 20 the transport to the original sequence, and Theorem 16 the equivalence with Erdos-Graham Question 5.
sources.claim_ceiling_consequence: Because Theorem 16 identifies the pseudo-greedy conjecture with Erdos-Graham Question 5, any local result phrased as pseudo-greedy termination is a restatement of the open question, not progress past it. Public wording must not present the equivalence as a partial solution.
remaining_debt: compare the journal PDF against the hash-pinned arXiv source before treating journal pagination or version-specific wording as checked
sources.identity_resolution_note: The archive was imported via arXiv identifier 2504.05933. The official INTEGERS index independently lists the same title and author as volume 26 (2026), A28; exact theorem comparison in this route is against the arXiv source.
